## Historical delivery

Commit `d10db7b4a` added production `type/no-matching-clause` warnings for multi-clause function heads by extending the source-time AST diagnostics pass. It restored the diagnostic behavior required by that ticket and its then-current fixture contract.

## Superseded authority

The source-time pass has no demanded typed activation inputs, skips important semantic cases, and duplicates the production dispatch analysis. It is not the final coverage authority.

fz-kdt.36.1 replaces this implementation with warning evidence contributed by the demanded `AnalyzeActivation` attempt from correlated `ActivationInputs`, then removes `source_diagnostics::check_function_clauses` and this production path. The historical commit remains the provenance of the code being removed; its policy is not a current acceptance rule.
